title: Link-layer oversized-frame test contradicts 254-byte body limit
description: Python link-layer focused tests fail because test_oversized_send_rejects_before_signing_without_mutation expects an 'exceeds 255' error, while spec section 4.1 and frame.py correctly cap the one-byte Length field body at 254 bytes (255 bytes total including Length). Update the assertion to the normative 254-byte body limit and retain the pre-signing/no-state-mutation checks.
